## Resource targets
- [ ] **Advisory goal:** Seek fewer routed Slice LUTs than the baseline of 55 on `xc7a35tcpg236-1`; record the routed count even if the experiment finds no reduction.

## Timing targets
- [ ] The routed timing report for the 10.0 ns clock shows setup slack (WNS) ≥ 0 ns and hold slack (WHS) ≥ 0 ns.

## Correctness
- [ ] Preserve the module ports, parameter defaults, synchronous reset behavior, and all observable cycle behavior; the fixed provided testbench reports `TEST PASSED`.
- [ ] Static/interface checks and compilation pass using the fixed provided testbench, tools, device, and constraints, without modifying the harness.

## Code quality
- [ ] The candidate remains a synthesizable `counter` design for the specified target, with no unresolved synthesis errors.

## Definition of done
